sections.passage:
Many people today are worried about overpopulation. A city is overpopulated when its population becomes larger than its resources and its infrastructure can support, so that there are not enough houses, jobs or services for everyone. Among the most overpopulated cities in the world today we can name Tokyo, Delhi, Shanghai, Dhaka and Cairo. Living in small towns, on the other hand, also has its drawbacks: there are fewer jobs, fewer good schools, less entertainment and limited medical services.

In this text, four young women talk about their lives in different cities. Whitney is a thirty-year-old lawyer, so she is no longer a teenager. Elsa lives in Boston, a city located on the eastern coast of the United States. Monica is not from California; she is from Massachusetts, and her plan is to finish her studies and become a teacher. Her father works in a small factory, and his employer could make his employees happier by raising their salaries and offering them better working conditions. The fourth woman, Rachel Tompkins, is not pessimistic about her city's future; on the contrary, she is optimistic and believes it will keep growing and improving.

In total, four girls' names are stated in the reading: Whitney, Elsa, Monica and Rachel. Their stories remind us that, whether a place is crowded or quiet, people everywhere look for work and a better life. Indeed, someone is unemployed when he or she does not have a job and is looking for one.

sections.passage:
Sir William Thompson was a famous scientist, but he had one little problem: he was rather deaf, and he did not always hear well what people said to him. One evening, he went to a dinner with some friends. During the meal, one of his friends began to tell a long and funny story to the guests. Sir William Thompson did not hear his friend's story very well, because of the noise in the room and his difficulty in hearing.

When the friend reached the end of his story, all the guests laughed politely. A few moments later, Sir William Thompson suddenly laughed so loudly that everybody turned to look at him. The truth was that he had misunderstood the whole story, and he was laughing at something completely different from what his friend had said. His story is therefore very different from his friend's: the friend told a real joke, while Sir William laughed because of a simple misunderstanding. Of course, Sir William Thompson was not deaf and dumb. He was deaf, but he could speak perfectly well, and he told the company, with a smile, that he had not understood a single word.

questions.model_answer:
L'affirmation "Si ce n'était pas l'argent, personne ne vous aurait aimé et aidé" présente une vision cynique des relations humaines, suggérant que l'amour et l'aide sont uniquement motivés par le gain financier. Bien que l'argent joue indéniablement un rôle important dans la société moderne et puisse influencer les interactions, il est réducteur de penser qu'il est le seul facteur déterminant dans les relations humaines. 

Il est vrai que l'argent peut faciliter l'accès à certaines formes d'aide et d'affection. Par exemple, une personne riche peut attirer des partenaires intéressés par son statut financier, ou peut se permettre d'embaucher des soignants et des assistants. Cependant, l'amour et l'aide authentiques sont souvent basés sur des liens émotionnels, des valeurs partagées et un désir sincère de soutenir l'autre. 

De nombreuses personnes offrent leur amour et leur aide sans attendre de récompense financière. Les parents aiment leurs enfants inconditionnellement, les amis se soutiennent mutuellement dans les moments difficiles, et les bénévoles consacrent leur temps et leur énergie à aider les autres. Ces exemples montrent que l'amour et l'aide peuvent exister indépendamment de l'argent. 

En conclusion, bien que l'argent puisse influencer certaines relations, il n'est pas le seul facteur déterminant. L'amour et l'aide authentiques sont basés sur des liens émotionnels et des valeurs partagées, et peuvent exister indépendamment de la richesse matérielle. Il est donc faux de croire que personne ne nous aimerait et ne nous aiderait sans argent.

scaffold_blanks.label: Thèse principale
scaffold_blanks.answer: L'égalité entre les hommes et les femmes est un objectif difficile à atteindre malgré des progrès.

scaffold_blanks.label: Exemples de discrimination
scaffold_blanks.answer: Discrimination dans l'éducation, l'emploi, la politique et les droits juridiques.

scaffold_blanks.label: Progrès réalisés
scaffold_blanks.answer: Droit de vote, de posséder des biens et de poursuivre une carrière.

scaffold_blanks.label: Actions nécessaires
scaffold_blanks.answer: Lutter contre la violence à l'égard des femmes, promouvoir l'éducation des filles et garantir une représentation égale dans les postes de direction.

questions.model_answer:
La question de l'égalité entre les hommes et les femmes est un sujet complexe et multidimensionnel. Bien que des progrès significatifs aient été réalisés dans de nombreuses sociétés en matière d'égalité des sexes, une véritable égalité reste un objectif difficile à atteindre. Dans de nombreuses régions du monde, les femmes continuent de subir des discriminations dans des domaines tels que l'éducation, l'emploi, la politique et les droits juridiques.

Il est indéniable que les femmes ont historiquement été désavantagées. Les normes culturelles et les stéréotypes de genre ont souvent limité leurs opportunités et leur ont refusé les mêmes droits et privilèges que les hommes. Par exemple, dans de nombreux pays, les femmes ont un accès limité à l'éducation et aux soins de santé, ce qui entrave leur capacité à réaliser leur plein potentiel. De plus, les femmes sont souvent sous-représentées dans les postes de direction et sont confrontées à un écart salarial entre les sexes, même lorsqu'elles occupent des emplois similaires à ceux des hommes.

Cependant, il est important de reconnaître que des progrès ont été réalisés. Les mouvements féministes et les efforts de défense des droits des femmes ont conduit à des changements juridiques et sociaux importants. Dans de nombreux pays, les femmes ont désormais le droit de voter, de posséder des biens et de poursuivre une carrière. De plus, les attitudes sociales évoluent progressivement, avec une reconnaissance croissante de la valeur et des contributions des femmes dans tous les domaines de la vie.

Malgré ces progrès, il reste encore beaucoup à faire. L'égalité des sexes ne consiste pas seulement à donner aux femmes les mêmes droits et opportunités que les hommes, mais aussi à remettre en question et à démanteler les structures et les systèmes qui perpétuent la discrimination et l'inégalité. Cela nécessite un effort concerté de la part des gouvernements, des organisations de la société civile et des individus pour promouvoir l'égalité des sexes dans tous les aspects de la vie. Par exemple, il est essentiel de lutter contre la violence à l'égard des femmes, de promouvoir l'éducation des filles et de garantir que les femmes aient une représentation égale dans les postes de direction.

En conclusion, bien que des progrès aient été réalisés, les femmes ne sont pas encore pleinement égales aux hommes dans de nombreuses régions du monde. La réalisation d'une véritable égalité des sexes nécessite un engagement continu à remettre en question les normes culturelles, à démanteler les structures discriminatoires et à promouvoir les droits et les opportunités des femmes.

answer_parts.label: Progrès réalisés
answer_parts.answer: Droit de vote, de posséder des biens et de poursuivre une carrière.

answer_parts.label: Actions nécessaires
answer_parts.answer: Lutter contre la violence à l'égard des femmes, promouvoir l'éducation des filles et garantir une représentation égale dans les postes de direction.

For a long time, the history of immigration to Canada was marked by inequality. Although Canada presented itself as a land of opportunity open to all, the reality was very different for many newcomers. A large part of the blame can be placed upon the Canadian government itself, which for decades shaped its policies according to the origin of the immigrants.

So, a large proportion of the population living outside the AMP, in search of work, service and education come to reside in this city. Called migrants, they face many difficulties because of their status. Describe joy and sorrows of the migrants of the AMP, (minimum 10 lines, maximum 25 lines).
hints: Réfléchissez aux aspects positifs et négatifs de la vie des migrants.

questions.model_answer:
L'Aire Métropolitaine de Port-au-Prince (AMP) attire de nombreux migrants en quête de travail, de services et d'éducation. La joie de ces migrants découle souvent de l'espoir d'une vie meilleure. Ils envisagent des opportunités économiques améliorées, l'accès à une éducation de qualité pour eux-mêmes ou leurs enfants, et la possibilité d'échapper à la pauvreté et au manque d'opportunités dans leurs régions d'origine. L'excitation de découvrir une nouvelle ville, de rencontrer de nouvelles personnes et de s'immerger dans une culture différente peut également apporter de la joie.

Cependant, la vie de migrant dans l'AMP est également remplie de difficultés. Le coût de la vie élevé, en particulier le logement, peut être un fardeau important. Trouver un emploi stable et bien rémunéré peut être difficile, et de nombreux migrants se retrouvent à travailler dans des emplois précaires et mal payés. L'accès aux services de base tels que les soins de santé et l'éducation peut également être limité, en particulier pour ceux qui n'ont pas de papiers ou de relations. La discrimination et la xénophobie sont également des problèmes auxquels les migrants peuvent être confrontés. L'éloignement de la famille et des amis, ainsi que la difficulté de s'adapter à un nouvel environnement, peuvent entraîner un sentiment d'isolement et de solitude. La déception face à la réalité de la vie dans l'AMP, qui peut ne pas correspondre à leurs attentes initiales, est une autre source de tristesse pour de nombreux migrants. En résumé, l'expérience migratoire dans l'AMP est un mélange complexe de joie et de tristesse, d'espoir et de désillusion.

questions.question: Many people are living in extreme poverty all over the world? What can be done to cope with this issue?
hints: Consider factors contributing to poverty and potential solutions.

scaffold_blanks.label: Education and skill development

scaffold_blanks.answer: Investing in infrastructure, supporting SMEs, and promoting entrepreneurship

questions.model_answer: Extreme poverty is a pervasive global issue, affecting millions and demanding urgent attention. Several strategies can be implemented to address this complex problem. Firstly, promoting education and skill development is crucial. By providing access to quality education and vocational training, individuals can acquire the necessary skills to secure better employment opportunities and improve their economic standing. Secondly, fostering economic growth and creating jobs are essential. Governments and organizations should invest in infrastructure development, support small and medium-sized enterprises, and promote entrepreneurship to stimulate economic activity and generate employment. Thirdly, strengthening social safety nets and providing basic necessities are vital. Implementing social welfare programs, such as food assistance, healthcare, and housing support, can help alleviate the immediate suffering of those living in extreme poverty. Fourthly, promoting good governance and combating corruption are necessary. Transparent and accountable governance structures can ensure that resources are allocated effectively and reach those who need them most. Finally, international cooperation and development assistance play a significant role. Developed countries should provide financial and technical assistance to developing countries to support their efforts in poverty reduction. Addressing extreme poverty requires a multifaceted approach that combines education, economic growth, social safety nets, good governance, and international cooperation. By working together, we can create a more just and equitable world where everyone has the opportunity to live a life of dignity and prosperity.

answer_parts.label: Education and skill development
answer_parts.answer: Providing access to quality education and vocational training

answer_parts.label: Economic growth and job creation
answer_parts.answer: Investing in infrastructure, supporting SMEs, and promoting entrepreneurship

questions.model_answer:
The question asks for a discussion of whether parents or schools should teach children how to be good members of society, and for a personal opinion.

Some argue that parents are the primary educators, instilling values and morals from a young age. They teach children basic social skills, respect, and empathy through daily interactions and by setting examples. The home environment shapes a child's initial understanding of right and wrong, and parents have a unique influence on their children's development.

Others believe that schools play a crucial role in teaching children how to be good members of society. Schools provide a structured environment where children learn about citizenship, social responsibility, and cooperation. They interact with diverse peers and learn to navigate social situations, resolve conflicts, and work together towards common goals. Schools also teach academic subjects that contribute to a well-rounded understanding of the world and prepare students for future roles in society.

In my opinion, both parents and schools have essential roles to play in teaching children how to be good members of society. Parents lay the foundation for moral development and social skills, while schools provide a broader context for learning about citizenship and social responsibility. A collaborative approach, where parents and schools work together to reinforce positive values and behaviors, is the most effective way to ensure that children grow into responsible and contributing members of society. Ultimately, a child's social development is a shared responsibility, requiring the combined efforts of family, educators, and the community.

questions.model_answer:
The question asks for possible solutions to environmental pollution and a personal opinion.

Environmental pollution has become a pressing global issue, demanding immediate and comprehensive solutions. Several approaches can be adopted to mitigate its harmful effects. Firstly, promoting sustainable practices in industries is crucial. This involves implementing stricter regulations on emissions, encouraging the use of cleaner technologies, and incentivizing companies to adopt eco-friendly production methods. Secondly, investing in renewable energy sources, such as solar, wind, and hydro power, can significantly reduce reliance on fossil fuels, a major contributor to air and water pollution. Thirdly, promoting public awareness and education about environmental issues is essential. Educating individuals about the impact of their actions and encouraging them to adopt sustainable lifestyles can lead to significant changes in behavior.

Furthermore, international cooperation is vital in addressing environmental pollution. Countries must work together to establish common goals, share best practices, and provide financial and technical assistance to developing nations. This includes enforcing international agreements on pollution control and promoting sustainable development initiatives.

In my opinion, a multi-faceted approach that combines technological innovation, policy changes, and individual responsibility is necessary to effectively combat environmental pollution. Governments, industries, and individuals must work together to create a cleaner and more sustainable future for all. It is our collective responsibility to protect the environment for future generations.

sections.passage:
Noah Webster is often called 'the father of the American dictionary.' He believed that the young United States should have its own language, a little different from the English of Britain. For this reason, he worked for many years to describe and standardize American usage.

Early in his career, Webster wrote A Grammatical Institute of the English Language. His purpose was to give American schools a standardized textbook that would improve education and help to build national unity among the citizens of the new country.

Later, in 1828, Webster published his masterpiece, An American Dictionary of the English Language. This great work appeared in two volumes and contained about seventy thousand words. In it, Webster introduced simpler, American spellings: he wrote 'color' instead of 'colour,' 'center' instead of 'centre,' and 'theater' instead of 'theatre.' Thanks to Noah Webster, American English gained its own identity, and many of his spellings are still used today.

questions.question: 1. Music or reading. Which is the more important in the life of a child?
hints: Consider the unique benefits each offers to cognitive and emotional development.
Think about how each one can foster creativity and critical thinking.
Consider how both contribute to a well-rounded education.
questions.scaffold_text:
{{0}}, each offering unique benefits that contribute to their overall well-being. While it's challenging to definitively declare one as more important than the other, it's essential to recognize the distinct advantages each provides.

{{1}} Engaging with music, whether through playing an instrument, singing, or simply listening, stimulates various parts of the brain, improving memory, attention span, and problem-solving abilities. Furthermore, music provides an outlet for children to express their feelings and emotions, fostering self-awareness and emotional intelligence. The discipline required to learn an instrument also instills valuable life skills such as perseverance and patience.

{{2}} Through reading, children are exposed to diverse perspectives, cultures, and ideas, broadening their understanding of the world around them. Reading also stimulates imagination and critical thinking, encouraging children to analyze information and form their own opinions. Moreover, reading fosters empathy by allowing children to step into the shoes of different characters and experience their emotions.

Ultimately, the relative importance of music and reading depends on the individual child's interests, learning style, and developmental needs. {{3}}, providing children with opportunities to explore their passions and develop a wide range of skills. Rather than viewing them as competing priorities, it's more beneficial to recognize their complementary roles in shaping a child's intellectual, emotional, and social growth. Encouraging children to engage with both music and reading will equip them with the tools they need to thrive in a complex and ever-changing world.

questions.model_answer:
Both music and reading play crucial roles in a child's development, each offering unique benefits that contribute to their overall well-being. While it's challenging to definitively declare one as more important than the other, it's essential to recognize the distinct advantages each provides.

Music education fosters creativity, enhances cognitive skills, and promotes emotional expression. Engaging with music, whether through playing an instrument, singing, or simply listening, stimulates various parts of the brain, improving memory, attention span, and problem-solving abilities. Furthermore, music provides an outlet for children to express their feelings and emotions, fostering self-awareness and emotional intelligence. The discipline required to learn an instrument also instills valuable life skills such as perseverance and patience.

Reading, on the other hand, cultivates literacy, expands vocabulary, and enhances comprehension skills. Through reading, children are exposed to diverse perspectives, cultures, and ideas, broadening their understanding of the world around them. Reading also stimulates imagination and critical thinking, encouraging children to analyze information and form their own opinions. Moreover, reading fosters empathy by allowing children to step into the shoes of different characters and experience their emotions.

Ultimately, the relative importance of music and reading depends on the individual child's interests, learning style, and developmental needs. A well-rounded education should incorporate both music and reading, providing children with opportunities to explore their passions and develop a wide range of skills. Rather than viewing them as competing priorities, it's more beneficial to recognize their complementary roles in shaping a child's intellectual, emotional, and social growth. Encouraging children to engage with both music and reading will equip them with the tools they need to thrive in a complex and ever-changing world.

answer_parts.answer: Both music and reading play crucial roles in a child's development

answer_parts.answer: Reading, on the other hand, cultivates literacy, expands vocabulary, and enhances comprehension skills.

answer_parts.label: Conclusion: Integrated approach
answer_parts.answer: A well-rounded education should incorporate both music and reading

questions.final_answer: Both music and reading are important for a child's development.

questions.question: 2. "It is never too late to learn." What do you think of this statement?
hints: Consider the idea that learning is a lifelong process.
Think about the benefits of acquiring new knowledge regardless of age.

questions.scaffold_text:
L'affirmation "{{0}}" est une idée puissante et inspirante avec laquelle je suis entièrement d'accord. Elle suggère que l'âge ne devrait pas être un obstacle à l'acquisition de nouvelles connaissances ou compétences. L'apprentissage est un processus continu qui dure toute la vie et qui enrichit nos vies de multiples façons.

Premièrement, l'apprentissage stimule notre cerveau et maintient notre esprit vif. Lorsque nous apprenons de nouvelles choses, nous créons de nouvelles connexions neuronales, ce qui améliore notre mémoire, notre capacité de résolution de problèmes et notre pensée critique. Cela est particulièrement important à mesure que nous vieillissons, car cela peut aider à prévenir le déclin cognitif et à maintenir notre indépendance.

Deuxièmement, l'apprentissage nous ouvre de nouvelles perspectives et nous permet de mieux comprendre le monde qui nous entoure. Que ce soit en étudiant l'histoire, en apprenant une nouvelle langue ou en explorant un nouveau domaine scientifique, l'apprentissage nous expose à de nouvelles idées, cultures et façons de penser. Cela peut nous aider à devenir plus ouverts d'esprit, tolérants et empathiques envers les autres.

Troisièmement, l'apprentissage peut nous apporter un sentiment d'accomplissement et de satisfaction personnelle. Atteindre un objectif d'apprentissage, qu'il s'agisse de maîtriser une nouvelle compétence ou de terminer un cours, peut renforcer notre confiance en nous et notre estime de soi. Cela peut également nous donner un but et une direction dans la vie, surtout à des moments où nous pourrions nous sentir perdus ou incertains.

Enfin, l'apprentissage peut nous aider à nous adapter aux changements et aux défis de la vie. Dans un monde en constante évolution, il est essentiel de continuer à apprendre et à se développer pour rester pertinent et compétitif. Que ce soit en acquérant de nouvelles compétences professionnelles ou en apprenant à utiliser de nouvelles technologies, l'apprentissage nous permet de nous adapter aux nouvelles situations et de saisir de nouvelles opportunités.

En conclusion, je crois fermement qu'il n'est jamais trop tard pour apprendre. L'apprentissage est un processus continu qui peut enrichir nos vies de multiples façons, en stimulant notre cerveau, en nous ouvrant de nouvelles perspectives, en nous apportant un sentiment d'accomplissement et en nous aidant à nous adapter aux changements. Alors, quel que soit votre âge ou votre situation, n'hésitez jamais à vous lancer dans une nouvelle aventure d'apprentissage.

questions.model_answer:
S'adapter à une nouvelle vie n'est pas chose facile. Seriez-vous prêt à aller vivre dans un pays étranger ?

La perspective de vivre dans un pays étranger est à la fois excitante et intimidante. D'un côté, elle offre une opportunité unique de découvrir une nouvelle culture, d'apprendre une nouvelle langue et de rencontrer des gens différents. L'immersion dans un nouvel environnement peut élargir nos horizons, remettre en question nos idées préconçues et nous aider à grandir en tant qu'individus. On peut découvrir de nouvelles passions, acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une plus grande ouverture d'esprit.

D'un autre côté, s'installer dans un pays étranger implique de quitter sa famille, ses amis et ses repères. La barrière de la langue peut être un obstacle majeur, rendant la communication difficile et créant un sentiment d'isolement. Les différences culturelles peuvent également être source de malentendus et de frustrations. Il faut s'adapter à de nouvelles normes sociales, à de nouvelles habitudes alimentaires et à un nouveau système de valeurs.

Personnellement, je serais prêt à aller vivre dans un pays étranger si j'avais une bonne raison de le faire, comme une opportunité de travail intéressante ou un projet personnel qui me tient à cœur. Cependant, je prendrais le temps de bien me préparer en amont, en apprenant la langue, en me renseignant sur la culture et en établissant des contacts sur place. Il est essentiel d'être ouvert d'esprit, flexible et prêt à faire des compromis pour réussir son adaptation dans un nouvel environnement. Il faut aussi être conscient des défis potentiels et être prêt à les surmonter. En fin de compte, l'expérience peut être incroyablement enrichissante, mais elle demande un certain courage et une bonne dose de préparation.

questions.model_answer:
Pouvez-vous imaginer votre vie sans téléphone portable ? Expliquez.

Il est difficile d'imaginer la vie sans téléphone portable aujourd'hui. Le téléphone portable est devenu un outil indispensable pour la communication, l'accès à l'information et le divertissement. Il nous permet de rester en contact avec nos proches, de travailler en déplacement et d'accéder à une multitude d'informations en quelques clics. 

Sans téléphone portable, la communication serait beaucoup plus difficile. Il faudrait se fier aux téléphones fixes, aux lettres ou aux rencontres en personne pour communiquer avec les autres. Cela prendrait beaucoup plus de temps et serait moins pratique, surtout en cas d'urgence. L'accès à l'information serait également limité. Il faudrait se rendre dans une bibliothèque ou consulter des journaux et des magazines pour se tenir informé de l'actualité. La recherche d'informations spécifiques serait plus longue et plus fastidieuse.

Le divertissement serait également différent sans téléphone portable. Il faudrait se contenter de la télévision, de la radio ou des livres pour se divertir. Les jeux vidéo et les réseaux sociaux ne seraient pas accessibles en déplacement. L'organisation de la vie quotidienne serait également plus compliquée. Il faudrait se souvenir de tous les rendez-vous et des tâches à accomplir sans l'aide d'un agenda électronique. La navigation dans les villes inconnues serait plus difficile sans GPS.

En résumé, la vie sans téléphone portable serait beaucoup plus lente, moins pratique et moins connectée. Bien qu'il soit possible de vivre sans, il est indéniable que le téléphone portable a considérablement amélioré notre qualité de vie en nous offrant un accès facile à la communication, à l'information et au divertissement.

questions.question: What are the principal components of the Internet?
questions.explanation: Le passage énumère clairement les quatre composantes principales de l'Internet : « the hardware (computers, cables and modems), the protocols (the rules that let machines talk to one another), the software, and the content that people read and share ».

questions.model_answer:
Les principaux composants de l'Internet sont:

1.  L'infrastructure matérielle (Hardware): Cela comprend les serveurs, les routeurs, les câbles (fibre optique, câbles coaxiaux), les ordinateurs personnels, les smartphones et autres appareils connectés.
2.  Les protocoles: Ce sont les règles et les normes qui permettent aux différents appareils de communiquer entre eux. Les exemples incluent TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, SMTP.
3.  Les logiciels (Software): Cela comprend les systèmes d'exploitation, les navigateurs web, les applications et autres programmes qui permettent aux utilisateurs d'accéder à Internet et de l'utiliser.
4.  Le contenu: Cela comprend les sites web, les pages web, les données, les images, les vidéos et autres informations disponibles sur Internet.
5.  Les utilisateurs: Les personnes qui utilisent l'Internet pour communiquer, accéder à l'information et effectuer d'autres tâches.

questions.question: Choose one of the following topics (Eight lines at least): How can the Internet make life more pleasant?
hints: Think about how people communicate and access information.
Consider the Internet's impact on education, entertainment, and commerce.
Focus on specific examples like online learning, streaming services, or e-commerce.
questions.model_answer:
The Internet has revolutionized the way we live, making life more pleasant in numerous ways. Firstly, it provides instant access to information. We can research any topic, learn new skills, and stay updated on current events with just a few clicks. This empowers us to make informed decisions and expand our knowledge.

Secondly, the Internet facilitates communication. We can connect with friends and family across the globe through email, social media, and video calls. This helps us maintain relationships and feel connected, regardless of distance.

Thirdly, the Internet offers entertainment. We can watch movies, listen to music, play games, and explore virtual worlds. This provides a source of relaxation and enjoyment, helping us to de-stress and unwind.

Fourthly, the Internet enables online shopping. We can purchase goods and services from the comfort of our homes, saving time and effort. This is particularly convenient for people with busy schedules or limited mobility.

Fifthly, the Internet fosters creativity and collaboration. We can share our ideas, collaborate on projects, and connect with like-minded individuals through online communities and platforms. This promotes innovation and allows us to learn from others.

In conclusion, the Internet has undeniably made life more pleasant by providing access to information, facilitating communication, offering entertainment, enabling online shopping, and fostering creativity and collaboration. Its impact on our lives is profound and continues to evolve.

questions.question: Choose one of the following topics (Eight lines at least): If you were a millionaire, what would you do in order to help poor people?
hints: Consider the different areas where poverty exists: health, education, housing, etc.
Think about sustainable solutions, not just temporary fixes.
Focus on empowerment through providing resources and opportunities for self-sufficiency.
questions.model_answer:
If I were a millionaire, I would dedicate a significant portion of my wealth to helping poor people in a variety of ways. My primary focus would be on providing access to basic necessities such as food, shelter, and healthcare.

Firstly, I would establish and support food banks and soup kitchens in impoverished communities to ensure that people have access to nutritious meals. I would also invest in sustainable agriculture projects to promote food security and empower local communities to grow their own food.

Secondly, I would build and renovate affordable housing units to provide safe and stable shelter for homeless individuals and families. I would also partner with organizations that offer supportive services such as job training and counseling to help people transition out of poverty.

Thirdly, I would establish and support free healthcare clinics in underserved areas to provide access to essential medical services. I would also invest in research and development to find new and innovative ways to treat and prevent diseases that disproportionately affect poor people.

Fourthly, I would create scholarship programs to help students from low-income families access quality education. I believe that education is the key to breaking the cycle of poverty, and I would want to ensure that everyone has the opportunity to reach their full potential.

Finally, I would support microfinance initiatives to provide small loans to entrepreneurs in developing countries. This would empower them to start their own businesses and create jobs in their communities.

In conclusion, as a millionaire, I would use my wealth to address the root causes of poverty and create opportunities for poor people to improve their lives. My goal would be to empower them to become self-sufficient and live with dignity.
questions.final_answer: Help poor people as a millionaire

questions.model_answer:
A place I have visited and enjoyed is the beach in Jacmel, Haiti. Jacmel is a coastal town known for its beautiful beaches, vibrant art scene, and historical architecture. The beach itself is a long stretch of golden sand, bordered by clear turquoise water. The atmosphere is always lively, with local vendors selling crafts and delicious Haitian food.

What I particularly loved about Jacmel beach was the sense of community. Families gathered to picnic, children played in the waves, and musicians played traditional Haitian music. The energy was infectious and welcoming. I spent hours swimming in the warm water, sunbathing on the sand, and exploring the nearby shops and restaurants.

One of the highlights of my visit was watching the sunset over the ocean. The sky transformed into a canvas of vibrant colors, painting a breathtaking scene. It was a truly magical moment that I will never forget. The combination of natural beauty, cultural richness, and friendly people made Jacmel beach an unforgettable experience. I highly recommend visiting this gem of a place in Haiti.

After the hurricane, the humanitarian services think that the situation is very serious and that the victims need immediate assistance. questions.model_answer:
One of the most captivating books I've read recently is "Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind" by Yuval Noah Harari. This book offers a sweeping overview of the entire history of the human species, from the Stone Age to the present day. Harari explores how Homo sapiens rose to dominance, examining the key turning points in our history, such as the Cognitive Revolution, the Agricultural Revolution, and the Scientific Revolution.

What makes "Sapiens" so compelling is its ability to connect seemingly disparate events and trends. Harari masterfully weaves together insights from history, biology, philosophy, and economics to provide a holistic understanding of the human experience. He challenges conventional wisdom and encourages readers to question their assumptions about the world.

For example, the book delves into the unintended consequences of the Agricultural Revolution, arguing that it may have actually worsened the lives of many early farmers. It also explores the impact of money, empires, and religion on shaping human societies. Furthermore, Harari raises profound questions about the future of humanity, considering the potential risks and opportunities presented by technological advancements such as artificial intelligence and biotechnology.

"Sapiens" is not just a history book; it's a thought-provoking exploration of what it means to be human. It has broadened my perspective on the world and inspired me to think more critically about the choices we make as a species. I highly recommend it to anyone interested in understanding the past, present, and future of humanity.

sections.passage: English is full of colourful idiomatic expressions, and many of them use the names of food. An idiom is a group of words whose meaning is different from the meaning of each separate word. For example, when a mother is very proud of her daughter and loves her dearly, she may say, 'She's the apple of my eye.' A painter who depends on his painting to earn his living can say, 'Painting is my bread and butter.' When something is very easy to do, we say, 'It's a piece of cake.' And when we are not completely sure that a story is true, we listen to it carefully. Could you take it, with a grain of salt? Idioms make a language rich, lively and fun to learn.

La vie à la campagne offre souvent un rythme plus lent, un air plus pur et un sentiment de communauté plus fort. Les gens peuvent apprécier la tranquillité, la beauté naturelle et la possibilité de se déconnecter du stress de la vie urbaine. Les produits frais et les activités de plein air sont plus facilement accessibles. Cependant, la campagne peut aussi signifier un accès limité aux services, aux opportunités d'emploi et aux commodités culturelles. L'isolement peut être un problème pour certains.

En revanche, une grande ville comme Port-au-Prince offre une multitude d'opportunités en matière d'emploi, d'éducation et de divertissement. La ville est un centre d'activité culturelle, avec des musées, des théâtres, des restaurants et des événements qui se déroulent en permanence. L'accès aux soins de santé spécialisés et aux services est généralement meilleur. Cependant, la vie urbaine peut être stressante en raison de la pollution, de la criminalité et du coût de la vie élevé. Le bruit et la foule peuvent être accablants.

Personnellement, je préférerais vivre à la campagne. Bien que j'apprécie les opportunités qu'offre une ville, je valorise davantage la paix et la tranquillité, l'air pur et le sentiment de communauté que l'on trouve à la campagne. Je suis prêt à faire des compromis sur l'accès facile à certains services et commodités en échange d'une meilleure qualité de vie globale. La possibilité de se connecter avec la nature et de vivre à un rythme plus lent est très attrayante pour moi. En fin de compte, le choix entre la campagne et la ville est une question de préférence personnelle. Il n'y a pas de bonne ou de mauvaise réponse, seulement ce qui convient le mieux à chaque individu.

Choosing a profession is a significant decision that shapes one's future. It's not merely about earning a living; it's about finding a path that aligns with one's passions, skills, and values. For me, the profession that resonates most deeply is that of a software engineer.

My interest in software engineering stems from a fascination with technology and problem-solving. I've always been intrigued by how software powers the digital world, from the apps on our smartphones to the complex systems that run businesses. The ability to create something from nothing, to build solutions that can impact millions of lives, is incredibly appealing.

Software engineering also offers a dynamic and intellectually stimulating environment. The field is constantly evolving, with new languages, frameworks, and methodologies emerging all the time. This requires a commitment to lifelong learning and a willingness to embrace new challenges. I am excited by the prospect of continuously expanding my knowledge and skills in this ever-changing landscape.

Furthermore, software engineering provides opportunities for collaboration and teamwork. Working with other engineers, designers, and product managers to bring ideas to life is a rewarding experience. I believe that I possess the communication and interpersonal skills necessary to thrive in a collaborative environment.

Finally, I am drawn to the potential for innovation and creativity in software engineering. The ability to design and develop novel solutions to real-world problems is a powerful motivator. I am eager to contribute my own ideas and skills to the development of cutting-edge technologies.

In conclusion, my aspiration to become a software engineer is driven by a combination of passion for technology, a desire for intellectual stimulation, and a commitment to making a positive impact on the world. I am confident that this profession will provide me with a fulfilling and rewarding career.

My parents had lived in the same house for more than ten years, and they knew all the neighbours very well. On the day we left, our parents and our neighbours were very sad and emotional, and some of them even cried. The neighbours brought food and gifts to say goodbye. Ultimately, the success of the essay will depend on the clarity of the argument, the quality of the evidence, and the originality of the insights. sections.passage: The Internet can be described as a global network of computer networks that communicate by using a common system of rules called TCP/IP. Surfing the Net is a little bit different from using an encyclopedia: an encyclopedia is static, because its information never changes, while the Net is dynamic and is brought up to date every second of the day. Each site on the Net has its own electronic address, which we call a URL, or web address. Thanks to the Net, a person will be able to access information, communicate with people all over the world, and learn about almost any subject. For these reasons, the Internet has changed the way we live, work and study.

In addition to education and healthcare, I would also support initiatives that promote economic empowerment. This would involve providing micro-loans to aspiring entrepreneurs, helping them start their own businesses and create jobs in their communities. I would also invest in sustainable agriculture projects, providing farmers with the resources and training they need to increase their yields and improve their livelihoods. 

Furthermore, I would allocate funds to organizations that provide food, shelter, and other essential services to the homeless and those living in extreme poverty. I believe that everyone deserves a basic standard of living, and I would do everything in my power to ensure that their needs are met. Finally, I would support research into the root causes of poverty, seeking to develop innovative and effective solutions that can address the problem at its source. My goal would be to create a lasting impact, empowering individuals and communities to lift themselves out of poverty and build a brighter future.

sections.passage: The Internet is a worldwide network of computer networks that work together using a common language called TCP/IP. Approximately 60 to 70% of the world's population now has access to the Internet, and the number grows every year. The Internet has several principal components: the hardware, the software, and the content that people share. On the Net you can download software, read the news, and talk with friends who are far away. As with every single innovation, the Internet has its drawbacks: it can be used to spread false information, and some people spend too much time in front of the screen. Used wisely, however, the Internet is a powerful tool for learning and communication.

sections.passage: Traffic in the cities of Haiti is a serious problem. Generally, the city traffic is very congested and chaotic, especially in the capital, Port-au-Prince. The main cause of the increasing number of car accidents is the growing number of vehicles on the roads together with the poor condition of the roads. The situation is made worse because most of the streets in Port-au-Prince don't have names, so it is hard to give directions. Many drivers frequently fail to signal when they turn, either through negligence or through a lack of awareness of the rules. Such drivers frequently cause accidents that could easily be avoided. Better roads, clear signs and more discipline would make the traffic much safer.

Teachers play a vital role in shaping the future, and I would be proud to contribute to this important work. While the challenges of teaching are undeniable, the rewards are immeasurable. The opportunity to make a difference in the lives of students and to contribute to the betterment of society is a powerful motivator.

questions.question: Choose one of the following topics. (Ten lines at least). What will be your profession? Why?
hints: Consider your interests and skills when choosing a profession.

questions.scaffold_text:
Mon choix de profession se porte sur l'ingénierie civile. Depuis mon plus jeune âge, j'ai été fasciné par les structures qui nous entourent, des ponts majestueux aux gratte-ciel imposants. Comprendre comment ces constructions tiennent debout, résistent aux forces de la nature et servent les besoins de la société est un défi intellectuel qui m'attire énormément.

L'ingénierie civile est bien plus qu'une simple profession ; c'est une contribution tangible au bien-être de la communauté. En tant qu'ingénieur civil, je pourrai participer à la conception et à la construction d'infrastructures essentielles telles que des routes, des systèmes d'approvisionnement en eau, des bâtiments et des installations de traitement des déchets. Ces projets ont un impact direct sur la qualité de vie des gens, en améliorant leur mobilité, leur accès à l'eau potable et leur sécurité.

De plus, l'ingénierie civile est un domaine en constante évolution, avec des défis nouveaux et passionnants à relever. Les préoccupations environnementales, les changements climatiques et les avancées technologiques exigent des solutions innovantes et durables. Je suis particulièrement intéressé par le développement de techniques de construction écologiques et de matériaux respectueux de l'environnement.

Enfin, je crois que l'ingénierie civile offre de nombreuses opportunités de développement personnel et professionnel. Je pourrai travailler en équipe avec d'autres ingénieurs, des architectes, des entrepreneurs et des représentants des collectivités locales. Cette collaboration me permettra d'acquérir de nouvelles compétences, d'élargir mes horizons et de contribuer à des projets d'envergure.

En conclusion, mon choix de devenir ingénieur civil est motivé par ma passion pour les structures, mon désir de contribuer au bien-être de la société, mon intérêt pour les défis environnementaux et mon aspiration à un développement personnel et professionnel continu. Je suis convaincu que cette profession me permettra de réaliser mon potentiel et de faire une différence positive dans le monde.

questions.model_answer:
Mon choix de profession se porte sur l'ingénierie civile. Depuis mon plus jeune âge, j'ai été fasciné par les structures qui nous entourent, des ponts majestueux aux gratte-ciel imposants. Comprendre comment ces constructions tiennent debout, résistent aux forces de la nature et servent les besoins de la société est un défi intellectuel qui m'attire énormément.

L'ingénierie civile est bien plus qu'une simple profession ; c'est une contribution tangible au bien-être de la communauté. En tant qu'ingénieur civil, je pourrai participer à la conception et à la construction d'infrastructures essentielles telles que des routes, des systèmes d'approvisionnement en eau, des bâtiments et des installations de traitement des déchets. Ces projets ont un impact direct sur la qualité de vie des gens, en améliorant leur mobilité, leur accès à l'eau potable et leur sécurité.

De plus, l'ingénierie civile est un domaine en constante évolution, avec des défis nouveaux et passionnants à relever. Les préoccupations environnementales, les changements climatiques et les avancées technologiques exigent des solutions innovantes et durables. Je suis particulièrement intéressé par le développement de techniques de construction écologiques et de matériaux respectueux de l'environnement.

Enfin, je crois que l'ingénierie civile offre de nombreuses opportunités de développement personnel et professionnel. Je pourrai travailler en équipe avec d'autres ingénieurs, des architectes, des entrepreneurs et des représentants des collectivités locales. Cette collaboration me permettra d'acquérir de nouvelles compétences, d'élargir mes horizons et de contribuer à des projets d'envergure.

En conclusion, mon choix de devenir ingénieur civil est motivé par ma passion pour les structures, mon désir de contribuer au bien-être de la société, mon intérêt pour les défis environnementaux et mon aspiration à un développement personnel et professionnel continu. Je suis convaincu que cette profession me permettra de réaliser mon potentiel et de faire une différence positive dans le monde.

questions.question: Choose one of the following topics. (Ten lines at least). Describe your daily activities.
hints: Think about the typical actions that fill a day.
Describe what you do from morning to evening.
Consider including details about work, leisure, and rest.
questions.model_answer:
My daily activities are quite routine, but I try to make the most of each day. I wake up early, usually around 6:00 AM, and start my day with a quick workout. This helps me to feel energized and focused for the rest of the day. After my workout, I take a shower and get dressed before having breakfast.

After breakfast, I head to school or work, depending on the day. I spend most of the morning and afternoon engaged in my studies or job responsibilities. I try to stay organized and prioritize my tasks so that I can be as productive as possible. During my breaks, I like to catch up with friends or read a book to relax.

In the evening, I usually have dinner with my family. We talk about our day and share stories. After dinner, I spend some time studying or working on personal projects. I also try to make time for hobbies, such as playing the guitar or painting. Before going to bed, I like to read a book or watch a movie to unwind.

On weekends, I have more free time to pursue my interests and spend time with loved ones. I often go hiking or biking in the mountains, visit museums or art galleries, or attend concerts or sporting events. I also enjoy cooking and trying out new recipes. Overall, my daily activities are a mix of work, study, and leisure, and I strive to maintain a healthy balance in my life.
questions.final_answer: A mix of work, study, and leisure

sections.passage: People wear clothes for many different reasons, and they do not all have the same ideas about the utility of clothes. The first use of clothes is protection. The utility of heavy clothes is to give us warmth in cold weather, while light clothes keep us cool when it is hot. Clothes also depend on culture. In North Africa, for example, the women get dressed in long, traditional clothing that covers most of the body. Some people are sure that their own way of dressing is the only correct one, but they want everybody else to conform to their ideas. Fashion also changes slowly: in Europe, for instance, respectable women wouldn't show their legs until the 20th century.

My mother taught me everything I know; she reminds me of an engineer, because making those complicated dishes is a kind of engineering feat, with exact measures and careful timing. sections.passage:
Two students, Barbara and Richard, are talking about the future, but they do not agree.

Barbara: I am very optimistic. I think the future will be wonderful. New technology will make our lives easier and help doctors to cure many diseases.

Richard: I disagree. I am worried about the future. Machines will take many jobs, and a lot of people will have nothing to do.

Barbara: But we will also protect the environment better. People are planting trees and using clean energy now.

Richard: I'm not so sure. If we continue to pollute, the planet will get warmer and life will become harder.

Barbara: Well, I believe that if we all work together, we can build a better world.

Richard: Maybe. I hope you are right, but I still think we must be very careful.

sections.instructions:
Answer the following questions in complete sentences after reading the text below. (20 pts.)

**Vaccination**

For all over a thousand years, smallpox was a disease that everyone feared. The disease killed much of the native population in South America when the Spanish arrived in the early century. By the end of the 18th century, smallpox was responsible for the deaths of about one in ten people around the world. Those who survived the disease were left with ugly scars on their skin.

It had long been well known among farmers that people who worked with cows rarely caught smallpox. Instead, they often caught a similar but much milder disease called cowpox. A British doctor called Edward Jenner was fascinated by that and so he studied cowpox. He became convinced that by vaccinating people with the disease he could protect them against the much worse disease, smallpox. In 1796, he vaccinated a boy with cowpox and two months later with smallpox. The boy didn't get smallpox. In the next two years, Jenner vaccinated several children in the same way, and none of them got the disease.

News of the success of Jenner's work soon spread. In 1800 the Royal Vaccine Institution was founded in Berlin, Germany. In the following year, Napoleon opened a similar institute in Paris, France. Vaccination became soon a common method to protect people against other viral disease, such as rabies and vaccines were sent across the world to the United States and India.

It took nearly two centuries to achieve Jenner's dream of getting rid of smallpox from the whole world. In 1967, the World Health Organization (WHO) started an ambitious program, and the last case of smallpox was recorded in Somalia in 1977. The story of vaccinations doesn't end there, however. There are many other diseases that kill more and more people every year. In addition, many new diseases are being discovered. The challenge for medical researchers will, therefore, probably continue for several more centuries.

questions.question: Warly is at the airport to catch a flight. She is on her way to her brother's wedding. Her flight is about to leave. As she runs through the terminal to her departure gate, an elderly man suddenly slips and falls in front of her. The man cries out in pain. Warly knows that if she stops to help the man, she will miss her flight. Consequently, if she misses her flight, she will miss her brother's wedding. Then as a decision, she just denies seeing the man. Would you have done the same if you had been Warly? Express yourself as clearly as possible.
hints: Think about the ethical implications of Warly's decision.

questions.model_answer:
If I were Warly, I would not have done the same. While attending my brother's wedding is important, the well-being of another human being takes precedence. My decision would be guided by empathy and a sense of moral responsibility. Missing a flight is a temporary inconvenience, but failing to help someone in need can have lasting consequences, both for the injured person and for my own conscience.

Firstly, I would immediately assess the man's condition. Is he conscious? Is he seriously injured? I would call for medical assistance, either by alerting airport staff or dialing emergency services. While waiting for help to arrive, I would try to comfort the man and reassure him that help is on the way.

Secondly, I would explain the situation to the airline staff. Most airlines are understanding in such circumstances and would likely rebook my flight without penalty. Even if there were a fee, the cost would be insignificant compared to the value of human life and the peace of mind that comes from doing the right thing.

Finally, I believe that helping someone in need reflects positively on my character and contributes to a more compassionate society. While missing my brother's wedding would be disappointing, I would be able to explain the situation to him, and I am confident that he would understand and appreciate my actions. Ultimately, choosing to help the elderly man aligns with my values and principles, and I would have no regrets about missing the flight.

Clear and accurate information about the benefits of vaccination should be disseminated through various channels, including radio, television, and community health workers. Addressing misinformation and building trust within communities is crucial.

Second, stakeholders should strengthen the healthcare infrastructure. This includes ensuring a reliable supply of vaccines, maintaining cold chain storage, and training healthcare workers to administer vaccines safely and effectively. Mobile vaccination clinics can be deployed to reach remote and underserved areas.

Third, collaboration and coordination among different stakeholders are essential. The Ministry of Health, international organizations, NGOs, and community leaders should work together to plan and implement vaccination campaigns. Data collection and monitoring systems should be established to track progress and identify areas that need improvement.

Finally, stakeholders should address the social and economic barriers to vaccination. Luisa Ramirez lived with her husband and her three children in a small house near the river. They were a simple but happy family. One night, after many days of heavy rain, the water of the river began to rise very fast. The police came to the neighborhood and told all the families to leave their homes immediately and move to a safer place.

The Ramirez family packed a few clothes into their old truck and drove to a shelter on the hill. When they came back, their house was full of mud and most of their things were destroyed.

Little by little, the Ramirez family was able to reconstruct a new way of life. They worked hard, helped their neighbors, and opened a small shop in the market. Thanks to their courage and their unity, they built a better future for their children.

questions.question: You are involved in a two-car crash one morning on your way to work. Accidentally, you hit and killed a pedestrian on the spot. As you get out of your car, you are suddenly caught by a tearful woman, the other vehicle driver, who strongly believes that she killed that pedestrian. You are only three on the scene: the woman driver, the dead body and you. Since the lady is convinced that she killed the pedestrian, what do you intend to do? (7 lines minimum)
hints: Consider the ethical implications of your actions in this scenario.
Think about the potential consequences of both telling the truth and remaining silent.
What would a truly honest person do, knowing the other driver is mistaken?
questions.model_answer:
Dans cette situation extrêmement difficile, je serais déchiré entre plusieurs considérations morales. Premièrement, mon instinct serait de dire la vérité. La vie d'une personne a été perdue, et la vérité est primordiale. Cependant, je serais également confronté à la détresse de la femme qui croit sincèrement être responsable. 

Je pense que je commencerais par évaluer la situation calmement. Est-ce que je suis absolument certain d'être responsable? Y a-t-il des preuves qui pourraient corroborer mon récit ou celui de la femme? Ensuite, je parlerais à la femme. J'essaierais de comprendre pourquoi elle est si convaincue d'être responsable. Peut-être a-t-elle une vision déformée de l'accident à cause du choc. 

Finalement, je crois que je me rendrais à la police et leur raconterais toute l'histoire, en insistant sur le fait que la femme croit également être responsable. Il appartiendrait alors aux autorités de mener une enquête approfondie et de déterminer les responsabilités. Il serait crucial de s'assurer que la vérité éclate, tout en tenant compte de l'état émotionnel de la femme et en lui offrant un soutien psychologique si nécessaire. Garder le silence serait un fardeau trop lourd à porter et une injustice envers la victime.

steps: Évaluer la situation calmement.
Parler à la femme pour comprendre sa perspective.
Se rendre à la police et raconter toute l'histoire.

After high school, I plan to pursue a career in software engineering. This choice stems from a combination of factors, including my aptitude for problem-solving, my fascination with technology, and the growing demand for skilled software developers in today's digital age.

Software engineering offers a unique blend of creativity and analytical thinking. It involves designing, developing, and testing software applications that solve real-world problems. I enjoy the challenge of breaking down complex tasks into smaller, manageable components and using my coding skills to bring innovative ideas to life.

Moreover, the field of software engineering is constantly evolving, with new technologies and programming languages emerging regularly. This continuous learning environment appeals to my intellectual curiosity and desire to stay at the forefront of innovation. I am excited about the prospect of working on cutting-edge projects and contributing to the development of new technologies that can improve people's lives.

Furthermore, the job market for software engineers is strong, with numerous opportunities available in various industries. This provides a sense of security and the potential for career advancement. I am confident that a career in software engineering will provide me with both personal fulfillment and financial stability.

Si je devais choisir un sport à pratiquer professionnellement, je choisirais le basketball. Plusieurs arguments solides justifient ce choix.

Premièrement, le basketball est un sport mondialement populaire, avec une ligue professionnelle très prestigieuse, la NBA, qui offre des opportunités exceptionnelles aux athlètes talentueux. La visibilité et les revenus potentiels dans le basketball professionnel sont très attractifs.

Deuxièmement, le basketball est un sport qui exige une combinaison unique de compétences physiques et mentales. La taille, la force, l'agilité, la coordination œil-main et l'endurance sont essentielles, mais la stratégie, la prise de décision rapide et le travail d'équipe sont tout aussi importants. Cette complexité rend le basketball stimulant et gratifiant.

Troisièmement, j'ai toujours été passionné par le basketball. J'aime l'excitation du jeu, la camaraderie de l'équipe et le défi de m'améliorer constamment. Cette passion me donnerait la motivation et la détermination nécessaires pour surmonter les obstacles et réussir dans le basketball professionnel.

Enfin, le basketball est un sport qui a un impact positif sur la communauté. Les joueurs de basketball professionnels sont souvent des modèles pour les jeunes et peuvent utiliser leur plateforme pour promouvoir des causes importantes. Je serais fier de représenter mon pays et d'inspirer les autres à travers le basketball.

Taking care of our health means making good choices and knowing where to find help. One of the greatest dangers to our health is smoking. The long-term damage caused by tobacco includes 85% of all lung cancer deaths. Smoking also causes many other problems, such as heart disease, breathing difficulties and several forms of cancer. Fortunately, there are many free programs to help people quit smoking.

Alcohol is another danger, especially for pregnant women. It is not good to drink alcohol during pregnancy, because it can cause serious damage to the unborn baby.

When we are sick, several professionals can help us. Doctors are not the only ones: pharmacists prepare and give us our medications, psychologists help us talk about our problems, and nurses take care of us in the hospital. If you need medication for a mental or psychological disorder, you should see a psychiatrist, who is a doctor specialized in the health of the mind. Knowing these professionals helps us protect both our body and our mind.

questions.model_answer: To reduce the trend of Haitian professionals leaving the country, several measures could be implemented. Secondly, investing in education and job creation is crucial. This includes providing scholarships and training programs to equip young people with the skills needed for the job market. The government should also incentivize businesses to create jobs and invest in Haiti. Thirdly, improving healthcare and infrastructure is essential. Access to quality healthcare and reliable infrastructure are important factors for professionals when deciding where to live and work. Fourthly, promoting good governance and the rule of law is necessary. This includes strengthening institutions, combating corruption, and ensuring that laws are enforced fairly. Finally, fostering a sense of national pride and patriotism can help to encourage professionals to stay and contribute to the development of their country. This could involve promoting Haitian culture and heritage, and celebrating the achievements of Haitian professionals both at home and abroad. By addressing these issues, the government can create a more attractive environment for Haitian professionals and reduce the brain drain.

sections.passage:
Ibrahim Cisse is a vibrant, confident sixth-grader. But when he moved to East Harlem from the Ivory Coast five years ago, he was a wide-eyed 8-Year-old boy who knew no one and spoke little English. It was Ibrahim’s passion for soccer that pushed him to play at his local park and joined the after school sports program.

Although his new friends spoke different languages, Ibrahim saw cultural and linguistic differences as opportunities, not barriers. “I like to talk to people and learn from them”, he said. “You can learn a lot from people who are different from you.”

The city program provides him and hundreds of other kids with a safe place to meet and play and offer academic tutoring and mentoring opportunities as well. Ibrahim’s transformation from isolated outsider to child athlete, peer mentor and community ambassador has made him wise beyond his years. “People need to start realizing that there’s no difference between us… white or any other color,” he said. “We are all the same. We need to listen to each other and respect each other.”

Cf.: Shine Bright. Nathan 2017

Dropping out of school at 15 has put you behind your peers, and while hobbies like playing cards and video games can be enjoyable, they don't offer long-term prospects. I strongly advise you to consider returning to school or pursuing vocational training. 

Education is an investment in your future. It opens doors to better job opportunities, higher earning potential, and personal growth. Even if you don't want to go back to a traditional high school, there are alternative options like adult education programs or online courses that can help you earn your diploma. 

Vocational training is another excellent option. It provides you with practical skills that are in demand in the job market. You could learn a trade like carpentry, plumbing, or electrical work, or pursue a career in healthcare, technology, or hospitality. 

I understand that it might be difficult to go back to school or start a new training program, but it's important to think about your future. Don't let your past mistakes define you. Community life can significantly contribute to personal achievement in several ways. Firstly, it provides a strong support system. When individuals are surrounded by a supportive community, they are more likely to take risks and pursue their goals, knowing they have people to fall back on. This support can come in the form of encouragement, advice, or even practical assistance.

Secondly, community life fosters collaboration and networking. By interacting with diverse individuals, people can learn new skills, gain different perspectives, and identify opportunities they might not have discovered on their own. Collaboration on projects and initiatives can also lead to shared successes and a sense of collective accomplishment.

Thirdly, community involvement promotes personal growth and development. Engaging in community activities, such as volunteering or participating in local events, can enhance leadership skills, improve communication abilities, and broaden one's understanding of the world. These experiences can be invaluable in both personal and professional life.

Finally, a strong community can provide a sense of belonging and purpose. Feeling connected to something larger than oneself can boost self-esteem, reduce stress, and increase overall well-being. This positive emotional state can, in turn, enhance motivation and drive, leading to greater personal achievement. In conclusion, community life offers a multitude of benefits that can significantly contribute to an individual's personal achievement.

sections.passage:
Nelson Mandela was a social rights activist, politician and philanthropist who became South Africa’s first black president from 1994 to 1999. After becoming involved in the anti-apartheid movement in his 20s, Mandela joined the African National Congress in 1942. For 20 years, he directed a campaign of peaceful, nonviolent defiance against the South African government and its racist policies.

Beginning in 1962, Mandela spent 27 years in prison for political offenses. In 1993, Mandela and South African President F.W. de Klerk were jointly awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for their efforts to dismantle the country’s apartheid system. For generations to come, Mandela will be a source of inspiration for civil rights activists worldwide.

Mandela was born on July 18, 1918, in the tiny village of Mvezo, on the banks of the Mbashe River in Transkei, South Africa. His birth name was Rolihlahla Mandela. “Rolihlahla” in the Xhosa language literally means “pulling the branch of a tree,” but more commonly translates as “troublemaker.”

When Mandela was 12 years old, his father died of lung disease, causing his life to change dramatically. He was adopted by Chief Jongintaba Dalindyebo, the acting regent of the Thembu people – a gesture done as a favor to Mandela’s father, who, years earlier, had commanded Jongintaba be made chief.

Mandela subsequently left the carefree life he knew in Qunu, fearing that he would never see his village again. He traveled by motorcar to Mqhekezweni, the provincial capital of Thembuland, to the chief’s royal residence. Though he has not forgotten his beloved village of Qunu, he quickly adapted to the new, more sophisticated surroundings of Mqhekezweni.

Cf. Reader’s digest 2000.

Answer the following questions according the text below. (20pts.)

**Children breaking down the language barrier**

When families migrate to Britain, parents often find it hard to engage with many aspects of society. Children who attend school or have been learning English in their home country often master the new language before their parents or other family members. Also, it is easier for younger people to integrate with a new community. As a result, the role of interpreter or mediator often falls to the children. They have to deal with a variety of situations; they have to translate medical information when their parents go to the doctor; they have to translate their teachers' messages; they also have to do the shopping in local shops, and even communicate with the social services.

This role as interpreter can make the children feel frustrated or embarrassed. Also, they sometimes have to miss school in order to attend appointments with their parents. Their situation of responsibility sometimes gives them authority over the parent.

It is not good practice to expect a young to interpret for other family members, particularly when it involves someone with an illness. Parents should be aware that the children should not have to interpret medical information or be involved in social or legal procedures.

*Source:* Cf.: Shine Bright. 2016

questions.model_answer:
Il est important pour les jeunes enfants d'apprendre des langues étrangères pour de nombreuses raisons cognitives et sociales. Premièrement, cela améliore les capacités cognitives telles que la résolution de problèmes et la pensée critique. Les enfants exposés à plusieurs langues développent souvent une meilleure mémoire et des compétences multitâches. Deuxièmement, cela favorise la sensibilisation culturelle et l'empathie, permettant aux enfants de mieux comprendre et apprécier différentes cultures et perspectives. Enfin, l'apprentissage des langues étrangères dès le plus jeune âge ouvre des portes à de futures opportunités académiques et professionnelles, préparant les enfants à un monde de plus en plus globalisé.

L'apprentissage précoce des langues étrangères stimule le développement du cerveau de manière unique. Les enfants qui apprennent une langue étrangère développent une plus grande flexibilité cognitive, ce qui leur permet de passer plus facilement d'une tâche à l'autre et de résoudre des problèmes complexes. De plus, l'apprentissage des langues étrangères améliore la mémoire et l'attention, des compétences essentielles pour la réussite scolaire. En outre, l'exposition à différentes langues et cultures favorise la créativité et l'innovation, car les enfants apprennent à penser différemment et à aborder les problèmes sous différents angles.

Au-delà des avantages cognitifs, l'apprentissage des langues étrangères favorise également le développement social et émotionnel des enfants. En apprenant une autre langue, les enfants développent une plus grande sensibilisation culturelle et une meilleure compréhension des autres. Ils apprennent à apprécier la diversité et à respecter les différences culturelles, ce qui les aide à devenir des citoyens du monde plus ouverts d'esprit et tolérants. sections.passage:
Marie Curie was one of the greatest scientists in history. She was born in Poland in 1867. As a young woman, she could not attend the university in Poland, because at that time the Polish universities did not admit women. For this reason, she travelled to Paris, where she studied physics and chemistry at the Sorbonne.

In Paris, Marie met a scientist named Pierre Curie, and they got married. Together they made an extraordinary discovery: they discovered radioactivity and two new elements, polonium and radium. For this work, Marie Curie received the Nobel Prize in Physics, and later a second Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

In 1906, a terrible tragedy struck: Pierre died in a street accident, when he was run over by a horse-drawn carriage. Marie was filled with sadness, but her sadness began to fade as she returned to the laboratory and continued their research. She dedicated the rest of her life to science.

sections.passage:
The mobile phone has become one of the most important objects in our daily lives. Many people feel anxious, disconnected and lost when they leave their mobiles at home, as if a part of them were missing.

There are many advantages to having a mobile phone. It allows instant communication with family and friends, gives quick access to help in an emergency, offers entertainment such as music and games, and provides an enormous amount of information. Through a mobile phone, a person can access the news, check the weather, read maps, and use social media at any time and from almost any place.

This is also why parents often allow their children to have mobile phones: for safety, for communication, and for education. However, there is a danger. Because of their convenience, their constant connectivity, and the fear of missing out, or 'FOMO,' people are becoming more and more dependent on their phones. We must learn to use this powerful tool wisely.

sections.passage:
The Olympic Games

The Olympic Games are the greatest sporting event in the world. They began in ancient Greece, but they disappeared for many centuries. The Modern Olympic Games were reintroduced in 1896, in Athens, thanks to the efforts of a Frenchman, Baron Pierre de Coubertin. Since then, they have been organised every four years. The event is governed by the IOC, which stands for the International Olympic Committee.

Organising the Games is a huge task. The responsibility of the host city is enormous: it must prepare the sports infrastructure, provide accommodation for thousands of athletes, guarantee security, and promote the event around the world. Next to the Olympic Games, the world also celebrates the Paralympic Games, which are intended for disabled athletes and which show the same spirit of courage and excellence.

However, the Olympic Games can also carry some negative aspects. They are extremely expensive, they sometimes force the displacement of local populations, they can damage the environment, and they are not free from political controversies. Despite this, the Olympic Games remain a powerful symbol of peace, friendship and human achievement.

questions.question: A gangster has robbed a supermarket, but instead of keeping the money for himself, he distributed it to the poor that cannot afford to feed, clothes and care for their children. If you denounce the robber, he would be arrested and put to jail and there's a possibility that the money will be returned to the supermarket, leaving a lot of kids in need. If you were that eyewitness, what would you do? Write a short paragraph to jot down your opinion
hints: Consider the moral implications of both actions: justice versus compassion.
Think about the potential long-term consequences for the community involved.
Would reporting the crime truly benefit the greater good in this situation?
questions.model_answer:
Cette situation présente un dilemme éthique complexe. D'un côté, le vol est un crime et le gangster devrait être dénoncé à la justice. La loi doit être respectée et les criminels doivent être tenus responsables de leurs actes. Dénoncer le gangster permettrait potentiellement de récupérer l'argent volé et de le restituer au supermarché.

D'un autre côté, le gangster a utilisé l'argent volé pour aider des familles pauvres qui n'ont pas les moyens de subvenir aux besoins de leurs enfants. Si je le dénonce, ces familles se retrouveront à nouveau dans une situation de détresse. Il est difficile d'ignorer l'impact positif que le gangster a eu sur ces personnes, même si ses actions étaient illégales.

Dans cette situation, je serais partagé. Je pense qu'il serait important d'enquêter plus en profondeur sur les motivations du gangster et sur les circonstances de son acte. Peut-être qu'il existe des solutions alternatives, comme trouver des moyens d'aider les familles pauvres sans avoir à recourir au vol. Je pourrais essayer de contacter des organisations caritatives ou des agences gouvernementales pour leur demander de l'aide. Je pourrais également essayer de parler au gangster et de le convaincre de se rendre à la police et de coopérer avec les autorités. En fin de compte, ma décision dépendrait de ma conviction quant à la meilleure façon de servir la justice et de protéger les personnes vulnérables.

steps: Identify the conflicting values (justice vs. compassion)
Consider the consequences of each action
Explore alternative solutions
